mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_orders ( order_id, store_id, platform_type, platform_order_id, external_store_id, status, source_sequence, last_event_version, ordered_at, gross_order_amount, customer_paid_amount, merchant_funded_discount, provider_funded_discount, provider_financial_data_status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{storeId}, #{platformType}, #{platformOrderId}, #{externalStoreId}, #{status}, #{sourceSequence}, #{lastEventVersion}, #{orderedAt}, #{grossOrderAmount}, #{customerPaidAmount}, #{merchantFundedDiscount}, #{providerFundedDiscount}, #{providerFinancialDataStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, store_id, platform_type, platform_order_id, external_store_id, status, source_sequence, last_event_version, ordered_at, gross_order_amount, customer_paid_amount, merchant_funded_discount, provider_funded_discount, provider_financial_data_status, created_at, updated_at FROM report_orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
